entries.title: Where should I start?
entries.summary: A quick guide to finding the information you need.

content.text:
Welcome to the **Cleaner Royall Documentation & FAQs** preview. Use the search bar to find an answer, or choose a category to narrow the list.

- **General** contains common help articles.
- **Premium** is for premium-related information.
- **Cleaner Model** contains technical references and code examples.

content.title: For this test
content.text: These are sample entries to demonstrate the interface. Replace the sample text with your verified documentation before publishing.

entries.title: How does search work?
entries.summary: Search titles, summaries, tags and text in article content.

content.text: Enter a word or phrase in the search field. Search checks each entry's **title, summary, tags, category and content text**. You can combine search with the FAQs or Documentation filter.

content.title: Tip
content.text: Use **All content** to remove the type filter. Choose *View all* or the bottom **All articles** action to clear every filter.

entries.title: Supported text formatting
entries.summary: A small example of the built-in Markdown-like renderer.

content.text:
## Readable articles

Use **bold text**, *italic text*, `inline code`, links like [OpenAI](https://openai.com), and simple lists.

> Important notes can be presented as a quote.

### A smaller heading

1. First step
2. Second step
3. Third step

content.title: Markdown limitation
content.text: The first version supports a small, safe subset of Markdown rather than raw HTML or a full Markdown library. Use dedicated JSON content blocks for code, warnings and steps.

entries.title: Where do Premium details belong?
entries.summary: Use this section for verified Premium questions and answers.

content.text: This is a placeholder FAQ for the **Premium** category. Replace it with your actual Premium policy, supported features, purchase guidance and troubleshooting steps. Avoid promising benefits that are not part of the current app release.

content.title: Before publishing
content.text: Verify any pricing, access, renewal, or entitlement information and keep it up to date.

entries.title: Premium troubleshooting template
entries.summary: A suggested structure for a support guide.

items: Describe the problem and the exact message shown.
List the checks a user can safely perform.
Explain how to collect relevant diagnostic information without sharing secrets.
Provide the official support or feedback contact.

content.title: Writing suggestion
content.text: Keep each step short. Put risky or irreversible operations in a clearly labelled warning.

entries.title: JSON data example
entries.summary: Demonstrates a formatted JSON code block with a copy button.

content.text: Use a code block when you need to show a data structure. The viewer preserves indentation and provides a one-tap copy action. This payload is generic demonstration data, not a required CleanerModel schema.

content.title: Remember
content.text: Document required fields, optional fields and default values next to the example.

entries.title: Java code example
entries.summary: A short Java snippet showing the copyable code viewer.

content.text: Java examples can include a title and language label. The code panel uses a horizontally scrollable area for long lines.

content.title: ExampleJava.java
Code examples
content.text: Provide the imports, minimum Java version and required dependencies when they are necessary to make an example runnable.

entries.title: Shell command example
entries.summary: Displays terminal commands in a copyable panel.

content.text: Use a shell code block when a guide includes commands. Explain prerequisites and the working directory, and show expected output when it helps the reader.

content.title: Safe demonstration command
content.code: printf '%s\n' 'Replace this with a documented command'

content.title: Command safety
content.text: Clearly explain what a command does before sharing commands that need elevated privileges or can modify or delete data.
